doc.name: Overwing
doc.description: Checks text before an agent sends or acts on it, and identifies AI crawlers and agents from a User-Agent string. Send a message with the text and get back a verdict and one recommended action: block, redact, review or allow. Answers at once; it is a service, not a conversation. Overwing also makes Tower, clearance for agents operating legacy business systems, which is called over REST or MCP, not A2A.

organizationKey.description: Optional. ow_live_... from POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup lifts the free limits

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Optional. ow_live_... from POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup lifts the free limits

authentication.description: No credential is needed. A key (ow_live_...) lifts the free limits.

skills.name: Check text before it ships
skills.description: Score a draft, a model's output, or an incoming message. Returns a verdict (pass, fail, review), one recommended action (block, redact, review, allow), and per-rule results with calibrated confidence.
examples: Is this reply safe to send to the customer?
Does this draft leak personal data the recipient does not already have?
skills.auth: Organization key, or pay per request with no account
skills.price: Free tier 250 a day; $0.002 per request over x402

skills.name: Identify a User-Agent
skills.description: Say what a User-Agent string claims to be and whether the claim can be trusted: operator, purpose, and verification method.
examples: Who is 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; GPTBot/1.2)' and can I verify it?
Is this request from a signed agent or a spoofable string?
skills.price: 10 a day with no key; 100 a day with a free key; $0.001 per lookup over x402

skills.name: Tell Overwing what went wrong
skills.description: One message to the people who run Overwing: a wrong verdict, an error you could not act on, a payment you could not make. Read by a person; leave a contact if you want an answer.
examples: The verdict on evaluation abc123 was wrong: the recipient owned that phone number.
The 402 on /api/x402/atlas/lookup names a network my wallet cannot pay on.

restOnly.name: Check whether a site is reachable by agents
restOnly.description: One lookup of a site: can an agent find it, read it and use it. Checks robots.txt, llms.txt, the MCP server card, endpoint and Registry listing, the A2A agent card and OpenAPI, and how the home page reads to a model. Returns a score, three answers and the fixes worth making.
examples: What should this product change so agents can use it?
restOnly.auth: None for the summary or to pay per check; an Overwing key for the full report free
restOnly.price: Free through POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/beacon/checks: the full report with a key (POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup issues one), the summary without. $1 per check over x402 with no account. Free sample at https://overwing.ai/api/v1/beacon/sample

restOnly.name: Operate a legacy system with clearance
restOnly.description: Request a typed operation on a system of record, such as entering an order on IBM i. Each write is executed, sent to a person for review, or refused, and every step is recorded in a signed receipt.
examples: Enter purchase order PO-88213 for customer C04471.
Cancel the order I created from this email.
restOnly.auth: Agent key, created by the organization
restOnly.price: $0.25 per executed action; 1,000 decisions free each month
